items.title: Faster, cleaner session re-attach
items.text: Reopening Ghoztty brings your persistent terminal sessions back quicker and renders them correctly right away, via a structured snapshot + delta replay instead of raw scrollback dumps. No more smeared or mis-sized panes when a window restores, and a RESIZE can no longer be dropped during re-attach.

items.title: No more spurious "update the agent" prompts
items.text: Upgrading the app no longer nags you to reset live terminal sessions to adopt a background agent that didn't actually change. The agent is now flagged "new" only when its own code really changed, not on every app release.
